name: Bean Rust
description: A fungal rust disease producing reddish-brown pustules on bean leaves and pods. It can cause severe defoliation and yield loss under favorable conditions, particularly in humid tropical environments.
symptoms: Small white spots on lower leaf surfaces turning into reddish-brown pustules
Pustules rupturing to release rust-colored spores
Yellow halos surrounding pustules on upper leaf surfaces
Leaves turning yellow and dropping prematurely
Pod infection causing reduced seed quality
causes: Extended leaf wetness from dew or rain
Dense canopy with poor air circulation
Wind-borne spores traveling from nearby infected fields
treatments: Apply fungicides containing tebuconazole or propiconazole
Spray mancozeb or chlorothalonil at 7-10 day intervals
prevention: Maintain adequate plant spacing for ventilation
Remove and destroy crop debris after harvest
Practice crop rotation with non-legume crops
